evidence_frontier: Exp021 (100‑epoch, 10‑seed) reported aggregate Q.ANT correct 887 for Alpha5 w8 versus 897 for the w16 control (gap = 10). The earlier 50‑epoch w8 confirmation (5‑seed) failed with 424 vs 441 (gap = 17). A subsequent 100‑epoch w8 confirmation (5‑seed) succeeded with 444 vs 448 (gap = 4). These results suggest longer training narrows the performance gap between w8 and the w16 baseline.
analysis: Observation: Shorter training (50 epochs) leaves w8 substantially behind the w16 control (gap > 10). Observation: Extending training to 100 epochs reduces the gap to within the preregistered tolerance (gap ≤ 4) and even meets the relative gate. Hypothesis: Training Alpha5 w8 for 100 epochs on ECG200 is sufficient to achieve aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions within 10 of the concurrent w16 control, confirming the w8 boundary under the prescribed protocol.
hypothesis: If Alpha5 w8 is trained for exactly 100 epochs on the ECG200 training split using the preregistered seed set [42,43,44,45,46], then its aggregate Q.ANT correct count on the ECG200 test split will be at least the w16 control's aggregate correct minus 10 (i.e., candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10).

proposal.title: 100‑epoch w8 Confirmation on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Does training Alpha5 w8 for 100 epochs close the performance gap to the Alpha5 w16 control on ECG200 as required by the relative aggregate gate?
proposal.rationale: Exp021 indicated a 10‑point gap at 100 epochs, while the 50‑epoch confirmation failed. A 100‑epoch confirmation previously succeeded, but an independent replication with the exact preregistered seeds is required to solidify the evidence and satisfy the laboratory’s reproducibility standards before proceeding to downstream architectural explorations.

procedure: Train Alpha5 w8 and concurrent Alpha5 w16 control on ECG200 train split (100 samples) for 100 epochs using seeds [42,43,44,45,46]
Evaluate both models on ECG200 test split (100 samples)
Aggregate predictions to obtain 500 total predictions per model

proposal.success_criteria: candidate_correct >= control_correct - 10 on the 500 aggregated predictions (5 seeds × 100 test samples)
proposal.risks: Potential variance in simulation results could cause the relative gate to fail despite adequate training; compute time for 5 seeds at 100 epochs may exceed allocated wall‑clock limits; no physical hardware claims are made.
